create_Subtraction_forward: create a Subtraction forward pass that computes (n, nsample, c) output from two (n, c) inputs and an (n, nsample) index tensor
create_Subtraction_backward: create a Subtraction backward pass that computes gradient tensors for two input features from a gradient output
test_subtraction_apply: test the subtraction.apply callable that wraps Subtraction for use as a torch.autograd.Function
run_subtraction_forward_cuda: run the subtraction_forward_cuda CUDA kernel to scatter feature differences indexed by idx
run_subtraction_backward_cuda: run the subtraction_backward_cuda CUDA kernel to accumulate gradients back to input tensors
